summary_en: FY8/26 dividend per share raised to ¥28 (from ¥24 forecast). Payout ratio target set at 40%. New policy effective FY8/26.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of FY8/26 Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kojima Co., Ltd. announced on 13 July 2026 that its board has approved a change in dividend policy and a revision (increase) to the FY8/26 year-end dividend forecast.

The company has set a quantitative target payout ratio of 40% to enhance shareholder returns. Under this new policy, effective from FY8/26, the year-end dividend per share has been raised from the previously forecast ¥24 to ¥28, representing a ¥4 increase. The prior year (FY8/25) paid ¥22 per share (¥20 ordinary dividend plus ¥2 commemorative dividend). The revision reflects the company's view that performance-backed profit distribution, supported by earnings forecasts and balance-sheet strength, warrants enhanced shareholder return.
